title: Effect of copy.
bodyText: A copy of an advance mental health care directive, revocation of an advance mental health care directive, or designation, revocation, withdrawal, or rescission of withdrawal of an agent has the same effect as the original.
bodyHtml: [§327G-12]  Effect of copy.  A copy of an advance mental health care directive, revocation of an advance mental health care directive, or designation, revocation, withdrawal, or rescission of withdrawal of an agent has the same effect as the original. [L 2004, c 224, pt of §2]
